corrected_value.authors: Miyake F, Nagaya K, Masuda K and Nakamura T
corrected_value.title: A signature of cosmic-ray increase in AD 774–775 from tree rings in Japan.

decisions.quote: Firstly, we present new 14C measurements over the period from 771–779 CE, spanning the years of the 775 CE event. Our results show the same sharp rise shown by Miyake et al. (2012), even though the Δ14C values are on average higher than the ones reported from the original study.
decisions.reason: The new 771–779 CE measurements directly retest Miyake et al. (2012)'s 775 CE increase, separately from the 1052 CE Brehm comparison. The reference identifies the 2012 Nature paper. The sole shipped original is Brehm et al. (2021), DOI 10.1038/s41561-020-00674-0). Parent reviewed the cited results/purpose and reference identity against all supplied shipped originals. This decision confirms the missing paper-level pair only; its overall outcome has not been adjudicated.
